rationale: Y has a distinctive serif display headline, a warm terracotta/forest palette and bespoke SVG illustrations per class, giving it a clear identity and a polished, cohesive finish. X has a convincing timetable UI card in the hero but otherwise reads as a familiar sage-green SaaS template with small, generic feature tiles and a dead empty area below the hero fold. Y is the one a design director would ship; X is more template-like.
